title: Branching conversation prototypes — scratch PRD and notes
body:
Quick context: jotting down a lightweight PRD + user stories for a branching conversation feature. Idea came out of last week's design sync — users want to try alternate directions mid-thread without losing history. This is a personal sketchpad; many TODOs and open Qs below.

Problem statement:
- Users in multi-turn assistants frequently want to explore alternate lines of thinking from an earlier turn (e.g., "what if we took a different approach at turn 3").
- Current session model is strictly linear; branching requires copying, forking, or duplicating threads which is clumsy and heavy.
- Need a low-friction in-app mechanism to create and switch between branches while keeping costs and latency predictable.

Goals (MVP):
1) Allow user to create a branch from any previous turn in a session. Branch is lightweight: references original context + diverging deltas.
2) Keep UI simple: visual breadcrumb of branches, ability to name/save branch, switch back and forth.
3) Server-side: represent branches as "session variants" with shared KV cache where possible to avoid recompute.
4) Cost transparency: show token delta per branch and approximate extra cost for continued exploration.

Non-goals (MVP):
- Full multi-user collaborative branching (no shared live edits yet).
- Long-term persisted branches in Dedicated/private long-term storage (MVP: branches live for 30 days).

High-level approach (architecture notes):
- Client: createBranch(turn_id, label) -> POST /sessions/{id}/branches with origin_turn and optional metadata.
- Server: materialize branch metadata, keep pointer to base session KV snapshot + incremental messages only. When a branch is activated, runtime will rehydrate KV cache from base snapshot + deltas if compatible with model variant.
- Fallback: if KV incompatible (model/quantization mismatch), fall back to re-run prefix through runtime or create a temporary warmup job.

User stories (rough):
US-1: As a power user, I want to create a branch from an earlier assistant reply so I can try a different follow-up without losing the canonical thread.
Acceptance:
- Can right-click or tap the timestamp on a message -> "Create branch" -> prompted to name it (optional).
- Branch appears in UI as a sibling timeline.
- Original timeline remains unchanged.

US-2: As a user, I want to compare outputs across branches side-by-side to pick the best answer.
Acceptance:
- Select two branches -> "Compare" -> UI shows both last-turn outputs and token counts.

US-3: As a developer integrating sessions API, I want branch metadata in API responses so I can render branching UI on web/mobile.
Acceptance:
- /sessions/{id} returns branches: [ {branch_id, origin_turn_id, label, created_at, last_active} ]

US-4: As an ops engineer, I want branches to reuse KV cache to avoid 2–3x token costs when exploring a forked path.
Acceptance:
- When model+seq len allow, runtime reuses base session KV up to origin_turn. Branching only sends deltas. Logs show cache_reused=true.

Metrics / success criteria (initial):
- Engagement: % of active sessions using at least one branch within 2 weeks of feature release > 3% (early signal).
- Cost delta: average token count per branched exploration < 1.5x baseline for equivalent depth.
- Latency impact: branch switch median latency < 250ms for cache-reuse paths.
- Retention: users who use branching have higher task completion rates (A/B target +5% conversion for experiment cohort).

UX sketch notes (quick):
- Inline gutter next to messages shows small fork icon on hover. Clicking opens mini-palette: "Create branch" / "Copy to new convo" / "Annotate".
- Branch bar above composer: pill chips with branch names, plus a "+" to create new branch from current view. Active branch pill highlighted.
- Compare modal: two-column with timeline scrubbers.

Implementation concerns / open questions (lots):
- How to represent deltas efficiently for KV rehydration? naive approach = store serialized messages and rebuild, better = snapshot KV at origin_turn. Storage cost vs compute tradeoff.
- Security: branches with PII — do we copy same retention policy? Likely yes but need opt-in policy for longer retention.
- Edge case: branching across model versions (user upgraded model mid-session). Should we block branch or transcode? Maybe allow but mark as "best-effort" and pre-warm.
- UI discoverability vs clutter: don't show branch UI to users on 1st-run; maybe progressive disclosure.

Experiment plan (alpha -> beta):
- Alpha internal (design/dev): enable for 50 internal accounts, collect logs re: cache reuse, failure modes, common branch depths.
- Beta: opt-in for 1% of real users via feature flag; A/B compare task completions and error rates.

Rough backend tasks (tech notes):
- API endpoint: POST /sessions/{sid}/branches -> returns branch_id. Minimal schema: branch_id, origin_turn_id, parent_session_id, label, kv_snapshot_id optional.
- Storage: branches table (sid, branch_id, origin_turn, snapshot_ptr, owner, expires_at). Add snapshotter job to create KV snapshot on createBranch (async).
- Runtime: extend session rehydrate path to check branch header -> try snapshot reuse -> else fall back to rebuilding prefix. Instrument metrics: kv_snapshot_present, kv_restored, prefix_replay_cost.

Backward compatibility: keep existing session API unchanged; branches are opt-in and won't affect linear sessions.

Future / stretch ideas:
- Branch merging: allow merging chosen branch back into canonical thread (with a merge decision / conflict resolution).
- Collaborative branching: multiple people can create branches and merge (requires ACLs).
- Branch templates: save a branch as a reusable seed for new conversations (like prompt recipes).

Next steps (short actionable list):
- Share this draft with Omar + Mira for API + UX sanity check (this week).
- Spike on KV snapshot vs prefix replay cost (Spike: bench 3 models, 4 sequence lengths) — assign to Noam. (ETA 2 wks).
- Design: quick mockups of branch bar + compare modal (Mira) — 1 week.
- Engineering: small API shape PR and storage migration plan (Omar) — 2 weeks.
- Decide alpha cohort and metrics logging keys (REDWOOD-1109)

Notes to self:
- Keep UX minimal at launch, avoid making branching the default mode.
- Think through telemetry labels early so we can track branch churn.
- Check privacy retention policy with legal for branch lifetime > 30 days.

Random ideas to capture (garage shelf):
- Time-travel slider that lets you preview branch state at any turn.
- Allow "experiment tags" on branches for A/B labels.
- Auto-suggest branches: system detects when user repeatedly asks variants and prompts to "Save as branch".

End of sketch. This feels promising but big surface area. Need to keep MVP minimal: only create, switch, compare, and server-side cheap reuse.
